body_markdown:
“I have used[Dream Sock](https://owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sock?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blog_post&utm_campaign=OwletStory) monitors for both my boys. When my youngest was 6 months old, he was diagnosed with RSV and we were told to monitor his oxygen levels and sent home from urgent care. Within 2 hours of getting home and putting him to bed, his oxygen levels were dipping to the numbers the doctor had warned us about. We ended up in the ER by 10pm and admitted by 4am due to his oxygen levels not being able to stabilize.


I don’t know what I would have done without having the ability to monitor and now the peace of mind every night.” - Samantha P.


Share your Owlet story[here](https://owletcare.com/pages/share-your-story?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=OwletStory) .


**As a reminder, Dream Sock® is intended to track your baby’s pulse rate and oxygen level and keep parents informed, but it is not intended to diagnose, treat or cure any disease or other condition including, but not limited to, Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS) and/or Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). This story reflects one family’s experience. Individual experiences may vary.*
